pieces.Text: If you have performed your daily obedience, as long as you carry a mask of the mantis (Inner Sea World Guide p.298) on your person (even if you do so by carrying it in an extradimensional space), you can instantly don it as a free action or as part of an attack of opportunity. While you wear a mask of the mantis, you can attempt to demoralize a creature within 30 feet using Intimidate as a swift action. You no longer need to expend charges from a mask of the mantis to gain the effect of deathwatch, although you must e17end charges as normal to use the mask's other effects.
